subject.title: Core hardening tracker: converge duplicated runtime invariants onto single owners

question: Should this protected tracker remain the canonical umbrella for the residual hardening slices, or should the remaining independently reviewable work move to narrower owned issues?
rationale: The remaining claims now span distinct session-storage, plugin/provider control-plane, and agent-runtime boundaries, while parts of the tracker have already landed or become obsolete.

options.title: Keep A Narrow Umbrella
options.body: Retain this tracker, refresh every row against current main, and require explicit maintainer sponsorship for each focused slice.

options.title: Split Residual Work
options.body: Create narrower canonical issues for each remaining owner boundary and close this umbrella only after those links exist.

options.title: Stop The Program
options.body: Close the tracker and revisit individual seams only after a concrete regression demonstrates renewed drift.

recommendation.title: Keep A Narrow Umbrella
recommendation.body: Retain this tracker, refresh every row against current main, and require explicit maintainer sponsorship for each focused slice.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent mainline ownership spans the session accessor, embedded runner, and provider-startup surfaces, and the issue timeline shows direct engagement.
